title: feat(voice): coalesced spoken notice when a native sub-agent finishes or fails (SV-5)
head: 8b81ab40e9cded41e01bea51de2b6c0652cc8289
brief: SV-5: one short spoken notice when a chat's native sub-agents finish or fail. HUD only, no daemon, provider or reader change. The first subagent bus record with op finished and status done/failed opens a fixed 3 s window per chat; endings inside it join one sentence ('A sub-agent finished.', 'Two sub-agents finished, one failed.'), queued through the shared speech queue as a notice item, local TTS only, no summary call. Never read: a child's prose, name, kind, brief, last tool or stop reason; notices.ts reads only sid, op, status, stop of a record. Silent: status stopped; a child whose record said stop: stopping|unconfirmed however it then ends; repeats; a chat not read now. Dropped by a send, Stop, an interrupted turn or the chat leaving its pane; waits while the owner is talking. Not posted to Discord. Settings > Voice > Sub-agent notices, per window, on by default.
focus: correctness, including under concurrency and across the ordering of events
handling of untrusted input, and safety-boundary changes
display, input and focus behaviour of the UI
test coverage of the new behaviour: would the tests fail without the change?
claims in the description against the evidence in the diff and tests

ground_truth.mechanism: the owner's main Stop is not remembered: it only drops a burst already waiting, so a child that ends done or failed after the interrupt (for example a Codex status the provider maps to failed) is spoken
ground_truth.evidence: feed turn_finished with stop 'interrupted', then a child finished record with status failed: a notice is queued; no test covers it

ground_truth.mechanism: the 'asked' memory is per window and built only from live bus records, so a window that reloaded or reconnected between the owner's Stop and the child's end announces a killed-then-failed child
ground_truth.evidence: reconnect the window after a child's stop: 'stopping' record, then reload, then a failed ending: notice spoken

ground_truth.mechanism: a notice has no staleness bound once it is in the queue: the floor never collapses a notice, so it can play late behind a long backlog
ground_truth.evidence: queue a long backlog ahead of a notice: it plays after the backlog with no expiry
